body:
Looked at this last night - seems like it'll be hard to fix because emscripten doesn't really have a way to pre-fetch WASM modules.

The best method I found (hypothetically; I didn't try to implement this specific one) would be to somehow inject the modules into `LDSO.loadedLibsByName` from the `instantiateWasm` function before it returns.

A potentially easier method would be to put the bytes of the dynamic libraries into `sharedModules`, but this doesn't work because that variable is not exported and doesn't exist at all if pthreads are not enabled, and my attempts to export it resulted in it being exported after emscripten had already started separate requests for all of the dynamic libraries.

We could also wrap `fetch` and do some kind of special case for the dynamic libraries but that feels like cutting the grass with a chainsaw.

A different way to do it would be to let emscripten keep requesting the dynamic libraries itself and then somehow extract the progress information from there, but I haven't looked into that route.
